script_text: Aquarius, your ruling planet Saturn retrograde in your 10th House of career is demanding restructuring — don't resist the shakeup coming this week. Early week brings Mercury in Virgo trining your 7th House of partnerships, making Tuesday ideal for negotiations or romantic conversations. However, the Sun squaring your 1st House of self-expression on Monday may create friction with authority figures. Mid-week shift: Jupiter enters your 8th House of shared resources on Wednesday, transforming your financial landscape. By Thursday, Venus sextiles your 5th House of love, intensifying romantic opportunities — single Aquarius, that stranger who catches your eye could be significant. Career-wise, expect a surprise windfall or inheritance discussion around Friday as Pluto in your 2nd House activates. Weekend brings emotional clarity as the Moon trines your 4th House of home.
